mintAuthority.summary: CADD is issued natively on Ethereum and Base by one issuer role graph, with the same MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE holders on both chains and no cap, timelock or proven multisig behind any of them. Per-chain issuance is unbounded and operator-mediated, with no contract conserving supply between the chains, but the pooled trust reserve is attested periodically across all deployments under CSAE 3000 and the issuer is prudentially supervised in Alberta.

controls.label: CADD MINTER_ROLE holder (Ethereum)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25774447 (2026-08-17 UTC), hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x4b37dd8b...) and the RoleGranted history confirm this address holds MINTER_ROLE (0x9f2df0fed...). eth_getCode returns 0xef0100 || 0x0000fb7702036ff9f76044a501ac1aa74cbab16b, the EIP-7702 delegation indicator for Fireblocks' verified UniversalGaslessDelegate. The delegate validates signatures but does not disclose the private-key custody policy behind this role holder. This Mint Authority control is scoped to the canonical Ethereum deployment; the identical Base role holder is authored separately as a Base Mint Authority control, since Base is native issuance rather than a representation.

controls.label: CADD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder (Ethereum)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25774447 (2026-08-17 UTC), hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xb3a77dd7...) and the RoleGranted history confirm this address holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. eth_getCode returns the Fireblocks UniversalGaslessDelegate indicator. The verified implementation assigns upgrades to a distinct UPGRADER_ROLE rather than DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. The corresponding Base role administrator is retained in Bridge Risk because Base is not proven to create independently reconciled native liabilities.

controls.label: CADD UPGRADER_ROLE holder (Ethereum)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25774447 (2026-08-17 UTC), the verified ERC20F implementation gates _authorizeUpgrade() with UPGRADER_ROLE 0x189ab7a9.... RoleGranted history and current hasRole calls identify 0x9367b51c... as the Ethereum holder. The Ethereum proxy resolves to implementation 0x0f25045d.... The upgrader account delegates to Fireblocks UniversalGaslessDelegate; no timelock is present and the underlying signer custody remains undisclosed. The same Base upgrade authority is recorded in Bridge Risk for the representation route.

controls.label: CADD MINTER_ROLE holder (Base)
controls.evidence: At Base block 50126464 (2026-08-18 UTC) the RoleGranted history and a direct hasRole read confirm 0x4b37dd8b672ba9f738d888e43ecfaf946cdcadd9 holds the same role on Base that it holds on Ethereum; the eight-role graph is identical across the two chains. Base is a native issuance surface rather than a representation: no adapter holds MINTER_ROLE, Base mints are overwhelmingly unpaired with Ethereum burns, and the CSAE 3000 attestation covers Base supply in the aggregate CADD in Circulation figure. This control is therefore scoped to the Base canonical deployment under Mint Authority.

sources.label: Tetra CADD reserve attestations (Baker Tilly WM, CSAE 3000)

review.evidence: Canonical-boundary review at Ethereum block 25774447 (2026-08-17T11:16:59Z): the Ethereum proxy resolves to implementation 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62, and current hasRole calls confirm 0x4b37dd8b holds MINTER_ROLE, 0xb3a77dd7 holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and 0x9367b51c holds UPGRADER_ROLE on the canonical Ethereum deployment. The verified ERC20F source exposes direct mint(address,uint256) behind MINTER_ROLE and UUPS _authorizeUpgrade() behind UPGRADER_ROLE, with no numeric mint cap. Tetra's terms state that each CADD issued is backed by CAD$1.00 held in trust and that redemptions burn CADD at a Burn Address on the applicable Supported Blockchain; Tetra lists Ethereum and Base with the same address. Those primary materials do not prove that Base maintains an independently reconciled reserve/liability ledger or disclose a bridge endpoint, adapter, peer, lockbox, validator, or supply-conservation mechanism. Under the conservative reopened determination, only Ethereum remains in Mint Authority as native issuance; the Base role, administration, upgrade, and pause surfaces are authored in Bridge Risk. The EIP-7702 role accounts delegate to Fireblocks' UniversalGaslessDelegate, but the private-key custody policy remains undisclosed. The registry records Alberta Treasury Board and Finance under Alberta's Loan and Trust Corporations Act as the named prudential regulator. Resolved 2026-08-18. The June 2026 Baker Tilly WM CSAE 3000 report defines CADD in Circulation as the total CADD token supply on the Base, Tempo and Ethereum chains against a single pooled trust reserve, so Base liabilities are reconciled at the aggregate level; there is no per-chain sub-ledger and none is required for the aggregate attestation to cover Base. No cross-chain mechanism binds Base minting to Ethereum burns: the eight-role AccessControl graph is identical on both chains, the same MINTER_ROLE holder was confirmed on both at 2026-08-18, no bridge adapter holds MINTER_ROLE on Base, and Base mints are overwhelmingly unpaired with Ethereum burns. Base is therefore native issuance and its role holders are authored here rather than under Bridge Risk. Tempo supply is not publicly readable and whether the issuer keeps an internal per-chain sub-ledger is undisclosed; neither bears on the questions this review had left open.
